description: This file defines the 'Delivery' class, which is an embeddable entity representing delivery address details in a shopping or order management system, with fields for personal and location information, including country and zone references.

classes.name: Delivery
classes.description: Embeddable entity class representing delivery address information with fields for name, company, address, city, postal code, state, telephone, and references to country and zone entities.

methods.name: getCompany
methods.description: Retrieves the company name associated with the delivery address.

methods.name: setCompany
methods.description: Sets the company name for the delivery address.

methods.description: Retrieves the street address for delivery.

methods.description: Sets the street address for delivery.

methods.name: setCity

methods.name: getPostalCode

methods.description: Sets the postal code for delivery.

methods.name: getCountry
methods.description: Retrieves the country entity associated with delivery.

methods.description: Sets the country entity for delivery.

methods.name: getZone
methods.description: Retrieves the zone entity associated with delivery.

methods.name: setZone
methods.description: Sets the zone entity for delivery.

methods.name: getState

methods.name: getTelephone
